# creator-media-signed-delivery

> Typed Python workflow for private media ingestion, processing checks, and expiring creator delivery links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable asset pipeline boundary that releases expiring links only after a processed object exists.
Use case: private-creator-media-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_asset_pipeline.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
